description: This file defines the LoggerConfigurator class, which serves as an abstract base class for classes responsible for configuring log4php logging framework instances using URLs. It includes constants for special level values, and a method stub for configuring log4php hierarchies based on URL resources.

classes.name: LoggerConfigurator
classes.description: An abstract class defining an interface for configuring log4php loggers via URLs. Includes a method stub 'doConfigure'.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Interprets a resource specified by a URL to configure logging settings. Intended to be overridden by subclasses.
